# --- Page 1: Fault List --- self.page_faults = QtWidgets.QWidget() self.setup_fault_page(self.page_faults) self.tab_widget.addTab(self.page_faults, "故障信息")

self.splitter.set_panels(content_widget, log_group, initial_log_height=100)
def setup_fault_page(self, parent): layout = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(parent) layout.setContentsMargins(20, 20, 20, 20) layout.setSpacing(15)
# Header Row: Title + Last Read Time + Filter Buttons header_layout = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout()

buttons = [self.btn_filter_all, self.btn_filter_curr, self.btn_filter_hist, self.btn_filter_pend] for i, btn in enumerate(buttons): filter_layout.addWidget(btn) self.filter_group.addButton(btn) # Add border radius to first and last radius_style = "" if i == 0: radius_style = "border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px;" elif i == len(buttons) - 1: radius_style = "border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px;"

header_layout.addWidget(filter_container) header_layout.addSpacing(10) header_layout.addWidget(search_container)
layout.addLayout(header_layout)
# Table self.fault_table = QtWidgets.QTableWidget() cols = ["序号", "故障码", "故障描述", "上报子系统", "状态码", "故障状态", "冻结帧状态", "冻结帧操作", "冻结帧数据"] self.fault_table.setColumnCount(len(cols)) self.fault_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(cols) self.fault_table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False) self.fault_table.setAlternatingRowColors(True) self.fault_table.setSelectionBehavior(QtWidgets.QAbstractItemView.SelectRows) header = self.fault_table.horizontalHeader() header.setSectionResizeMode(QtWidgets.QHeaderView.Interactive) header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtWidgets.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents) header.setSectionResizeMode(self.fault_table.columnCount() - 1, QtWidgets.QHeaderView.Stretch) header.setStretchLastSection(False) header.setSectionsClickable(True) header.setHighlightSections(True) header.setSectionsMovable(True) header.sectionResized.connect(lambda *_: self.adjust_column_widths())
# Install event filter for adaptive column resizing self.fault_table.installEventFilter(self)
self.fault_table.setShowGrid(False) self.fault_table.setFrameShape(QtWidgets.QFrame.NoFrame) layout.addWidget(self.fault_table)
# Pagination page_layout = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout() self.page_info_label = QtWidgets.QLabel("每页显示10条，共1页，共0条") self.page_info_label.setStyleSheet("color: #64748B;") page_layout.addWidget(self.page_info_label) page_layout.addStretch()
self.btn_prev = QtWidgets.QPushButton("上一页") self.btn_next = QtWidgets.QPushButton("下一页") self.lbl_page_num = QtWidgets.QLabel("1/1") self.lbl_page_num.setStyleSheet("color: #3B82F6; font-weight: bold; padding: 0 10px;")
for btn in [self.btn_prev, self.btn_next]: btn.setCursor(QtGui.QCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)) btn.setStyleSheet(""" QPushButton { border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; background: white; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 4px; color: #64748B; } QPushButton:hover { background: #F8FAFC; color: #333; } """)
page_layout.addWidget(self.btn_prev) page_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_page_num) page_layout.addWidget(self.btn_next)
layout.addLayout(page_layout)
def _create_filter_btn(self, text, checked=False): btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton(text) btn.setCheckable(True) btn.setChecked(checked) btn.setCursor(QtGui.QCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)) btn.setStyleSheet(""" QPushButton { background-color: white; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; color: #64748B; padding: 8px 20px; font-family: "Microsoft YaHei"; margin: 0px; } QPushButton:checked { background-color: #3B82F6; color: white; border-color: #3B82F6; } QPushButton:hover:!checked { background-color: #F8FAFC; color: #3B82F6; } /* Radius handling based on position property would require re-applying stylesheet or separate classes. Simplifying for now by not rounding corners perfectly or just rounding all slightly if not grouped perfectly. Let's try to make them look connected. */ """) return btn
def setup_freeze_page(self, parent): layout = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(parent) layout.setContentsMargins(20, 20, 20, 20) layout.setSpacing(15)
header_layout = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout() title = QtWidgets.QLabel("冻结帧数据") title.setStyleSheet("font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; color: #1E293B;") header_layout.addWidget(title)
self.freeze_time_label = QtWidgets.QLabel("最后读取时间：—") self.freeze_time_label.setStyleSheet("color: #64748B; margin-left: 15px; font-size: 14px;") header_layout.addWidget(self.freeze_time_label) header_layout.addStretch() layout.addLayout(header_layout)
self.freeze_table = QtWidgets.QTableWidget() cols = ["故障码", "故障描述", "类型", "DID", "长度", "Byte", "Bit", "参数名称", "数值", "单位"] self.freeze_table.setColumnCount(len(cols)) self.freeze_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(cols) self.freeze_table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
freeze_header = self.freeze_table.horizontalHeader() freeze_header.setSectionResizeMode(QtWidgets.QHeaderView.Interactive) freeze_header.setSectionsClickable(True) freeze_header.setHighlightSections(True) freeze_header.setSectionsMovable(True) freeze_header.setStretchLastSection(False)
self._freeze_column_weights = { 0: 12, # 故障码 1: 22, # 故障描述 2: 11, # 类型 3: 10, # DID 4: 7, # 长度 5: 7, # Byte 6: 7, # Bit 7: 18, # 参数名称 8: 12, # 数值 9: 9, # 单位（最后一列填充） } self._freeze_min_widths = { 0: 110, 1: 200, 2: 100, 3: 90, 4: 70, 5: 70, 6: 70, 7: 160, 8: 110, 9: 90, } self._freeze_widths_initialized = False
self.freeze_table.setShowGrid(True) self.freeze_table.setFrameShape(QtWidgets.QFrame.NoFrame)
layout.addWidget(self.freeze_table) QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda: self._apply_freeze_table_widths(force=True))
def append_log(self, message: str): OperationLogManager.instance().append_log("DTC故障诊断", message) ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f") if hasattr(self, 'log_edit'): self.log_edit.appendPlainText(f"[{ts}] {message}") # Scroll to bottom self.log_edit.moveCursor(QtGui.QTextCursor.End) else: print(f"[{ts}] {message}")
def populate(self, categories, dtcs): """ dtcs: List[Tuple(code, desc, subsystem, status_code, fault_state, freeze_state?)] """ # Update Filter Button Texts if categories and len(categories) >= 4: self.btn_filter_all.setText(categories[0]) self.btn_filter_curr.setText(categories[1]) self.btn_filter_hist.setText(categories[2]) self.btn_filter_pend.setText(categories[3])
# Update Fault Table self.fault_table.setRowCount(len(dtcs))
# Update Pagination Info (Mock) self.page_info_label.setText(f"每页显示10条，共1页，共{len(dtcs)}条")
for r, row in enumerate(dtcs): if len(row) >= 7: code, desc, subsystem, status_code, fault_state, freeze_state = row[:6] freeze_data = row[6] elif len(row) == 6: code, desc, subsystem, status_code, fault_state, freeze_state = row freeze_data = "" else: code, desc, subsystem, status_code, fault_state = row freeze_state = "未读取" freeze_data = ""
seq_item = QtWidgets.QTableWidgetItem(str(r + 1)) seq_item.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter) self.fault_table.setItem(r, 0, seq_item)
def make_center(text): it = QtWidgets.QTableWidgetItem(text) it.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter) return it
self.fault_table.setItem(r, 1, make_center(code)) self.fault_table.setItem(r, 2, make_center(desc)) self.fault_table.setItem(r, 3, make_center(subsystem)) self.fault_table.setItem(r, 4, make_center(status_code)) self.fault_table.setItem(r, 5, make_center(fault_state))
# Freeze Status with Dot status_widget = QtWidgets.QWidget() status_layout = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout(status_widget) status_layout.setContentsMargins(5, 0, 5, 0) status_layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
dot = QtWidgets.QLabel() dot.setFixedSize(10, 10) dot.setStyleSheet(f"background-color: {self._get_status_color(freeze_state)}; border-radius: 5px;")
lbl = QtWidgets.QLabel(freeze_state) lbl.setStyleSheet("margin-left: 5px;")
status_layout.addWidget(dot) status_layout.addWidget(lbl) self.fault_table.setCellWidget(r, 6, status_widget)
# Operation Button op_widget = QtWidgets.QWidget() op_layout = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout(op_widget) op_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0) op_layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("读取冻结帧") btn.setCursor(QtGui.QCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)) btn.setProperty("row", r) btn.clicked.connect(self.on_click_freeze_btn)
op_layout.addWidget(btn) self.fault_table.setCellWidget(r, 7, op_widget)
# Freeze Data data_item = make_center(freeze_data) data_item.setToolTip(freeze_data) self.fault_table.setItem(r, 8, data_item)
self.fault_table.setRowHeight(r, 50)
# Trigger resize adjustment after data load to ensure layout is correct QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(0, self.adjust_column_widths)
def populate_freeze_frame(self, data): """ Populate the freeze frame table. data: List of freeze frame records. Each record structure: { "code": "P31AE87", "desc": "...", "type": "Type A", "did": "0x0501", "length": 8, "params": [ {"byte": "0~1", "bit": "All", "name": "Speed", "value": "100", "unit": "km/h"}, ... ] } """ self.freeze_table.setRowCount(0) row_idx = 0
for item in data: params = item.get("params", []) start_row = row_idx count = len(params)
self.freeze_table.setRowCount(start_row + count)
# Common columns (merged) # 0: Code, 1: Desc, 2: Type, 3: DID, 4: Length common_vals = [item["code"], item["desc"], item["type"], item["did"], str(item["length"])]
for i, val in enumerate(common_vals): it = QtWidgets.QTableWidgetItem(val) it.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter) self.freeze_table.setItem(start_row, i, it) if count > 1: self.freeze_table.setSpan(start_row, i, count, 1)
# Param columns for p_idx, param in enumerate(params): r = start_row + p_idx
def set_item(c, txt): it = QtWidgets.QTableWidgetItem(str(txt)) it.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter) self.freeze_table.setItem(r, c, it)
set_item(5, param["byte"]) set_item(6, param["bit"]) set_item(7, param["name"]) set_item(8, param["value"]) set_item(9, param["unit"])
self.freeze_table.setRowHeight(r, 40)
row_idx += count
def _get_status_color(self, text): color_map = { "未读取": "#94A3B8", "读取中...": "#3B82F6", "读取成功解析成功": "#10B981", "读取成功解析失败": "#F59E0B", "读取失败": "#EF4444" } if text == "读取成功": return "#10B981" return color_map.get(text, "#94A3B8")
def set_last_read_time(self, dt: datetime): txt = f"最后读取时间：{dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')}" self.last_read_label.setText(txt) self.freeze_time_label.setText(txt)
def showEvent(self, event): super().showEvent(event) QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(0, self.adjust_column_widths) QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda: self._apply_freeze_table_widths(force=not self._freeze_widths_initialized))
def resizeEvent(self, event): super().resizeEvent(event) self.adjust_column_widths()
def on_read_dtcs(self): # Emit signal instead of handling logic self.read_dtc_signal.emit()
def on_clear_dtcs(self): self.clear_dtc_signal.emit()
def on_click_freeze_btn(self): btn = self.sender() if not btn: return row = btn.property("row") self.read_freeze_frame_signal.emit(row)
def on_filter_group_clicked(self, btn): if btn == self.btn_filter_all: self.filter_changed_signal.emit("all") elif btn == self.btn_filter_curr: self.filter_changed_signal.emit("current") elif btn == self.btn_filter_hist: self.filter_changed_signal.emit("history") elif btn == self.btn_filter_pend: self.filter_changed_signal.emit("pending")
def on_search_action(self): text = self.search_input.text() self.search_changed_signal.emit(text)
def update_freeze_read_status(self, row: int, status_text: str, data_text: str = ""): # Update status dot status_widget = self.fault_table.cellWidget(row, 6) if status_widget: # Rebuild the widget content # Clear layout layout = status_widget.layout() while layout.count(): child = layout.takeAt(0) if child.widget(): child.widget().deleteLater()
dot = QtWidgets.QLabel() dot.setFixedSize(10, 10) dot.setStyleSheet(f"background-color: {self._get_status_color(status_text)}; border-radius: 5px;")
lbl = QtWidgets.QLabel(status_text) lbl.setStyleSheet("margin-left: 5px;")
layout.addWidget(dot) layout.addWidget(lbl)
# Update freeze data column if data_text is not None: it = QtWidgets.QTableWidgetItem(data_text) it.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter) it.setToolTip(data_text) self.fault_table.setItem(row, 8, it)
if "成功" in status_text: # Switch to freeze tab and show mock data # In real app, controller would call populate_freeze_frame self.tab_widget.setCurrentIndex(1)
def eventFilter(self, source, event): if source == self.fault_table and event.type() == QtCore.QEvent.Resize: self.adjust_column_widths() return super().eventFilter(source, event)
def adjust_column_widths(self): if not self.fault_table or self.fault_table.columnCount() == 0: return
header = self.fault_table.horizontalHeader() total_width = self.fault_table.viewport().width() if total_width <= 0: return
last_col = self.fault_table.columnCount() - 1
try: header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtWidgets.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents) for col in range(1, last_col): header.setSectionResizeMode(col, QtWidgets.QHeaderView.Interactive) header.setSectionResizeMode(last_col, QtWidgets.QHeaderView.Stretch) except Exception: pass
# 不再重算前面列宽，保持原有列宽/用户拖动结果；最后一列自动填满剩余空间 try: header.resizeSection(0, self.fault_table.columnWidth(0)) except Exception: pass
def _apply_freeze_table_widths(self, force: bool = False): if not hasattr(self, 'freeze_table') or not self.freeze_table: return header = self.freeze_table.horizontalHeader() column_count = self.freeze_table.columnCount() if column_count == 0: return
total_width = self.freeze_table.viewport().width() if total_width <= 0: return
last_col = column_count - 1 try: for col in range(column_count): header.setSectionResizeMode(col, QtWidgets.QHeaderView.Interactive) header.setSectionResizeMode(last_col, QtWidgets.QHeaderView.Stretch) except Exception: pass
if not force and self._freeze_widths_initialized: return
weights = self._freeze_column_weights mins = self._freeze_min_widths total_weight = sum(weights.get(col, 1) for col in range(column_count))
widths = {} used = 0 for col in range(column_count - 1): weight = weights.get(col, 1) target = int(total_width * weight / total_weight) width = max(mins.get(col, 70), target) widths[col] = width used += width
remaining = total_width - used last_min = mins.get(last_col, 80) if remaining < last_min: deficit = last_min - remaining shrink_candidates = [1, 7, 8, 2, 3, 0, 4, 5, 6] for col in shrink_candidates: if deficit <= 0 or col not in widths: break current = widths[col] min_width = mins.get(col, 70) reducible = max(0, current - min_width) if reducible <= 0: continue reduce_by = min(deficit, reducible) widths[col] = current - reduce_by used -= reduce_by deficit -= reduce_by
try: for col, width in widths.items(): self.freeze_table.setColumnWidth(col, width) self._freeze_widths_initialized = True except Exception: pass

def populate_freeze_frame(self, data): """ Populate the freeze frame table. data: List of freeze frame records. Each record structure: { "code": "P31AE87", "desc": "...", "type": "Type A", "did": "0x0501", "length": 8, "params": [ {"byte": "0~1", "bit": "All", "name": "Speed", "value": "100", "unit": "km/h"}, ... ] } """ self.freeze_table.setRowCount(0) row_idx = 0
for item in data: params = item.get("params", []) start_row = row_idx count = len(params)
self.freeze_table.setRowCount(start_row + count)
# Common columns (merged) # 0: Code, 1: Desc, 2: Type, 3: DID, 4: Length common_vals = [item["code"], item["desc"], item["type"], item["did"], str(item["length"])]
for i, val in enumerate(common_vals): it = QtWidgets.QTableWidgetItem(val) it.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter) self.freeze_table.setItem(start_row, i, it) if count > 1: self.freeze_table.setSpan(start_row, i, count, 1)
# Param columns for p_idx, param in enumerate(params): r = start_row + p_idx
def set_item(c, txt): it = QtWidgets.QTableWidgetItem(str(txt)) it.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter) self.freeze_table.setItem(r, c, it)
set_item(5, param["byte"]) set_item(6, param["bit"]) set_item(7, param["name"]) set_item(8, param["value"]) set_item(9, param["unit"])
self.freeze_table.setRowHeight(r, 40)
row_idx += count

def eventFilter(self, source, event): if source == self.fault_table and event.type() == QtCore.QEvent.Resize: self.adjust_column_widths() return super().eventFilter(source, event)
def adjust_column_widths(self): if not self.fault_table or self.fault_table.columnCount() == 0: return
header = self.fault_table.horizontalHeader() total_width = self.fault_table.viewport().width() if total_width <= 0: return
last_col = self.fault_table.columnCount() - 1
try: header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtWidgets.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents) for col in range(1, last_col): header.setSectionResizeMode(col, QtWidgets.QHeaderView.Interactive) header.setSectionResizeMode(last_col, QtWidgets.QHeaderView.Stretch) except Exception: pass
# 不再重算前面列宽，保持原有列宽/用户拖动结果；最后一列自动填满剩余空间 try: header.resizeSection(0, self.fault_table.columnWidth(0)) except Exception: pass
def _apply_freeze_table_widths(self, force: bool = False): if not hasattr(self, 'freeze_table') or not self.freeze_table: return header = self.freeze_table.horizontalHeader() column_count = self.freeze_table.columnCount() if column_count == 0: return
total_width = self.freeze_table.viewport().width() if total_width <= 0: return
last_col = column_count - 1 try: for col in range(column_count): header.setSectionResizeMode(col, QtWidgets.QHeaderView.Interactive) header.setSectionResizeMode(last_col, QtWidgets.QHeaderView.Stretch) except Exception: pass
if not force and self._freeze_widths_initialized: return
weights = self._freeze_column_weights mins = self._freeze_min_widths total_weight = sum(weights.get(col, 1) for col in range(column_count))
widths = {} used = 0 for col in range(column_count - 1): weight = weights.get(col, 1) target = int(total_width * weight / total_weight) width = max(mins.get(col, 70), target) widths[col] = width used += width
remaining = total_width - used last_min = mins.get(last_col, 80) if remaining < last_min: deficit = last_min - remaining shrink_candidates = [1, 7, 8, 2, 3, 0, 4, 5, 6] for col in shrink_candidates: if deficit <= 0 or col not in widths: break current = widths[col] min_width = mins.get(col, 70) reducible = max(0, current - min_width) if reducible <= 0: continue reduce_by = min(deficit, reducible) widths[col] = current - reduce_by used -= reduce_by deficit -= reduce_by
try: for col, width in widths.items(): self.freeze_table.setColumnWidth(col, width) self._freeze_widths_initialized = True except Exception: pass
